description: Repurposed Mark Cross red box lid containing 13 miscellaneous tools used for sculpting and working with clay. Red box has a handwritten adhesive label by O'Keeffe on one end of box that reads: Pencils - in red ink.  Verso of box lid has a Mark Cross label in brown and gold.
